description:
Full Steam order book for one skin. Steam Community Market's current order book for the skin, straight from our scraper's latest snapshot:
`lowest_sell_order` and `highest_buy_order` (cents; null when that side is empty), `sell_order_count` and
`buy_order_count`, the COMPLETE `sell_orders` and `buy_orders` depth ladders as `[{price, quantity}, ...]`
best price first (every level Steam publishes, not a top-N cut), and `fetched_at`, when the snapshot was taken.
The headline ask is refreshed by a market-wide sweep every ~12 minutes; the depth ladders come from the
per-item rotation (every few hours), so they can trail it slightly. 404 when the skin has no Steam order book
(unmarketable items). Not cached: this is one indexed row.
name: get_skin_orderbook
title: Full Steam order book for one skin
